module.Title: Update Equipment Status
module.Teaching: Assigning through a dictionary key changes that field while preserving the other equipment data.
module.PredictionQuestion: What happens to the pump name?
module.PredictionExplanation: Only the addressed keys are modified.
module.DebugPrompt: Use assignment for running and += to increment hours.
module.RecallPrompt: Stop the pump and add one operating hour. Use these exact values: 1, False, "hours", "running".
module.TransferPrompt: Start fan and add five hours to its runtime. Use these exact values: 5, True, "running".
module.PreviewMessage: The dashboard can now reflect changing equipment state.
